def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[]
    for r in range(h):
        row=[]
        for c in range(w):
            # The grid is a repeating 1..9 progression; below the main diagonal
            # the progression is advanced by one, while the diagonal and upper
            # triangle use the column progression.
            n = c + (3 if c < r else 2)
            row.append((n-1)%9+1)
        out.append(row)
    return out
PY
